name: Black Cat Cue
note: Halloween 2026 (lane Cues B, brief 2.5, concept C2c_black_cat.png rev 3): a glossy black shaft with gold ring pairs, three gold claw slashes on a knurled forearm, a gold claw tip inlay, a triple gold collar and a living black tail with a thin gold rim; black smoke with gold-edged wisps and faceless shadow cats running in it. No head, no face, no eyes, no pink. Draft until complete.
